# Albumen: the open-source alternative to iCloud Photos, Google Photos and Frame.io.

> Open-source, bring-your-own-storage, MCP-native photo library. Originals are bit-exact, metadata is never lost, and a full export is one command.

Reliability, fidelity, respect, control, scale, and the measured performance and friction budgets are the metrics. Cost is outside those metrics. Scale means the library grows with the hardware: no artificial ceilings, streaming and paginated APIs, constant memory. The commitment is the design philosophy. The working guide for agents is AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [Design philosophy](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY.md): Bit-exact originals, checksums on the CI gate, never delete, one-step export, bring-your-own storage, respect for the user, the MCP cap, and scale with no artificial limits.
- [Performance budgets](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/docs/performance-budgets.md): Cold start, thumbnails, scroll, search, import, and backup CPU and battery. Client metrics are targets until the apps exist.
- [Friction](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/docs/friction.md): Steps from install to a first backup, and the sane-defaults, no-account, and no-nags rules.
- [Scale](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/docs/scale.md): No artificial ceilings. Soft defaults, streaming pages, and the safety bounds that stay.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Build and test commands, the round-trip gate, never-delete rules, and where to start.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Philosophy acknowledgment, Developer Certificate of Origin, and how agents contribute.
- [README](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/README.md): What the repository does today.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): Work that is not in the tree yet.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Ingest, export, the camera receiver, and the MCP server.
- [MCP server.json](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/server.json): Official registry metadata for `io.github.jay-the-maker/albumen`. Published by the `v*` workflow.
